htmlBody:
Frontier CEOs: start with Executive Papers. Today’s tip pairs the EGS Lattice-Linear Gateway (PDVSA ops mock) with moving up the stack (valuation framing). Then play the Frontier trail — self-test + Where Am I on the QUESTFEST board. Hospitality grammar and simulator demos, not live oilfield SLAs or a caste test.

If you want a map for that: What it means to be frontier — trail, self-test, Where Am I. Also new on the board: Moving up the stack — Lattice is the next AI layer ($12B–$28B).

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.

highlights.title: What It Means to Be Frontier
highlights.blurb: Modern holographic trail on the QUESTFEST board: Frontier Man vs Nester self-test and a Where Am I game between Basecamp and Goldilocks Earth / SS Vibelandia. Design language, not a caste test.

highlights.title: Moving Up the Stack
highlights.blurb: Chip and LLM players buy up the stack (Hugging Face $12.9B, Cursor $60B). Lattice Chat is the next shelf: cools token burn, harmonizes agents, scales agentic systems. New-layer framing $12B–$28B — not a peer on the old shelf. Fair Exchange, not an audited appraisal.

highlights.title: PDVSA Gateway Ops Mockup
highlights.blurb: Fleshed protocol paper + Infinite Octaves engine companion. Multi-domain Production·Field·Compliance·Export on one brief (SNA↔TCP/IP is the rhyme). Nine takeaways open the papers and math — simulator, not live PDVSA telemetry.
